install.title: Install SSH key — {{name}}
install.description: Generates a dedicated ed25519 key on this host (reused if it already exists), installs the public key on {{ip}}, and verifies key authentication. Passwords are used only for this installation; never stored or logged.
install.adminDescription: Use a server admin account to create the user and install the key. Enable this if {{user}} is not provisioned on the server yet. The admin must be root or have passwordless sudo.
install.installing: Generating key, installing on the server and verifying…
install.installedPublicKey: Installed public key (saved on the server record)

import.title: Import servers (CSV)
import.description: Paste the CSV or choose a file. Required header: SERVER_NAME,SERVER_IP,REMOTE_USER,DESCRIPTION. Existing servers with the same name are updated.
import.failed: Import failed. Check the CSV format.

page.title: Servers
page.description: Inventory of servers with SSH access.
page.emptyGroup: No servers found in this group.
page.showServices: Show services published by this server
page.turnOffNamed: Turn off ForgeHub's access to {{name}} (the key is kept)
page.turnOnNamed: Turn ForgeHub's access to {{name}} back on
page.openSshNamed: Open SSH terminal to {{name}} in Workspace

services.title: Services
services.scanTitle: Scan common ports on this server
services.scanDisabled: Access is turned off — turn it on to scan
services.empty: No services registered. Add one, or scan for open ports.
services.noOpenPorts: No open ports among the {{count}} checked.
services.scanResult: {{count}} of {{total}} ports answered. Nothing was saved; choose one to register it.
services.registerPort: Register this port as a service
services.nonWebTitle: Answers TCP but is not a web endpoint
services.removeDescription: Remove "{{name}}" ({{url}}) from {{server}}? Only the ForgeHub entry is deleted; nothing changes on the server.

form.createFailed: Could not save. The name may already exist.
form.name: Server name
form.copyPathPublicKey: Copy the public key of this path
form.sshKeyHelpAfter: when opening the SSH terminal. Leave blank to use the shell's default key or agent.
form.sshKeyCopyHelp: The copy button reads the public key (<path>.pub) and saves it to this record.
form.publicKeyHelp: Stored encrypted; filled automatically by the Install SSH key action.

vault.title: Key vault
vault.description: Keeps the private key encrypted in ForgeHub's database. If the file is lost on the host, server access can still be recovered. The key is never sent back to the browser; restoring writes it directly to the path above.
vault.storeTitle: Read the identity file from the host and store it encrypted
vault.pathRequired: Set an SSH key path first
vault.restoreTitle: Write the stored key back to the host (never overwrites an existing file)
vault.pastePlaceholder:
-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
…paste a key this host doesn't have…
vault.removeDescription: ForgeHub's encrypted copy of {{name}}'s key will be deleted. The file on the host remains; if it is ever lost, there will be no copy to restore.

passphrase.title: Key passphrase
passphrase.description: Passphrase that unlocks the identity file above. Stored encrypted and shown only to admins. A vaulted key without its passphrase cannot be recovered for use.
passphrase.leaveBlank: Leave blank if the key has none
passphrase.removeDescription: {{name}}'s key remains where it is; only the passphrase stored by ForgeHub is deleted. A protected key without its passphrase cannot be used by the status probe.

access.title: Access
access.enabledDescription: ForgeHub probes this server and can open a terminal to it.
access.disabledDescription: Parked: no status check or terminal. The key, vaulted copy, and server remain untouched.
